name: M3_PDS013MI_LstAltMat
description: List alternate material records defined for a product in a facility. The operation returns all alternate component materials that belong to the product structure, including identity, description, quantity settings, priority, issue method, normal waste, attribute reference, and text identity. It is read-only and is used to review how alternate materials are set up for planning and manufacturing across structure types and sequences for the selected product and facility.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility for which to list alternate material records.

inputParameters.name: PRNO
inputParameters.description: Product number whose product structure's alternate materials are to be listed.

inputParameters.name: STRT
inputParameters.description: Product structure type used to filter the alternate material records.

inputParameters.name: MSEQ
inputParameters.description: Sequence number of the material line used to filter the alternate material records.

inputParameters.name: MTAL
inputParameters.description: Alternate component item number used to filter the list of records.

inputParameters.name: FDAT
inputParameters.description: Start date from which valid alternate material records are listed.

outputParameters.name: FACI
outputParameters.description: Facility where the alternate material record is defined.

outputParameters.name: PRNO
outputParameters.description: Product number whose structure includes the alternate material.

outputParameters.name: STRT
outputParameters.description: Product structure type for which the alternate material record is defined.

outputParameters.name: MSEQ
outputParameters.description: Sequence number identifying the specific material line in the product structure.

outputParameters.name: MTAL
outputParameters.description: Item number of the alternate component in the product structure.

outputParameters.name: ITDS
outputParameters.description: Name or description of the alternate component item.

outputParameters.name: FDAT
outputParameters.description: Start date from which the alternate material record is valid.

outputParameters.name: PREX
outputParameters.description: Priority of this alternate material compared to other alternatives for the same component.

outputParameters.name: CNQT
outputParameters.description: Quantity of the alternate component used in the product structure.

outputParameters.name: PEUN
outputParameters.description: Unit of measure used to express the alternate component quantity in the product structure.

outputParameters.name: DCCD
outputParameters.description: Number of decimal places used when processing the component quantity for this alternate material.

outputParameters.name: SPMT
outputParameters.description: Method used to issue the alternate component to manufacturing or work orders.

outputParameters.name: WAPC
outputParameters.description: Expected scrap or waste percentage for the alternate component.

outputParameters.name: ATNR
outputParameters.description: Attribute number associated with this alternate material, if attribute-controlled.

outputParameters.name: TXID
outputParameters.description: Identifier for any text or comments linked to this alternate material line.

outputParameters.name: FXCD
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the alternate component quantity is fixed regardless of the order quantity.
